## Requirements: Frontend Pull & Refresh Lifecycle — 统一前端拉取、自动刷新与手动刷新

### Owner decision / scope (2026-11-26)
用户明确要求：统一的是前端拉取与刷新语义，而不是业务资源模型；目前 Session、Agent 与多项能力内列表不会及时更新，且很多列表没有手动刷新入口。目标是在现有 API/WS/Jotai/Explorer/业务 Hook 上提供轻量、可复用、可测试的前端机制，让当前可见数据最终收敛到既有 API 所提供的权威结果，并允许用户主动刷新。
**Non-goals:** 不建设 Resource System、Resource Registry/Key、统一业务缓存、后端 revision directory、全局数据模型、跨 Agent/Server 的新一致性协议；不改造 Terminal/AI 流式数据、不可变历史、编辑器草稿语义；不承诺普通查询可以修复 Server 自身陈旧状态。仅使用既有 force API 等已支持的权威查询语义。

### Verified baseline
main [a9d2c270](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62) 静态审查（非生产运行时复现）：
- [useRealtimeUpdates](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/app/useRealtimeUpdates.ts) 只在初始连接/重连拉 Agent/Session，另订阅完整 push；[useVisibilityReconnect](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/app/useVisibilityReconnect.ts) 前台恢复成功探测 server.info 后没有业务列表重读。
- [useAgentData](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/product/agent/hooks/useAgentData.ts) agentsEqual 只比较 id/status/count/name，遗漏 metadata/addresses/protocols/hostname/port/heartbeat；fetchAgents 无 request/push fence。[AgentsPlugin](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/product/agent/AgentsPlugin.ts) 已有物理连接 guard，但同连接旧 reply 发布协议 manifest 的顺序仍需检查。Server [control.rs](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/crates/nession-server/src/server/handler/control.rs) intentionally 不因 timestamp-only heartbeat 广播整个列表；通过普通 Pull 获取最新已知 heartbeat，不为此增加广播。
- [useSessionData](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/product/session/hooks/useSessionData.ts) 已有 realtimeRevision/requestSequence/instance metadata guard；[server_session_list_v1](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/crates/nession-server/src/server/handler/server_session_list_v1.rs) force=true 可重新枚举在线 Agent，保留 stale_agents。复用既有行为，不重复构建状态 owner。
- [useTranscripts](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/capabilities/claude-code/hooks/useTranscripts.ts) 明确仅手动/上下文拉取；[useEnvironmentProfiles](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/capabilities/env/hooks/useEnvironmentProfiles.ts) mount/refresh + generation；[useAgentWorkspaces](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/capabilities/sandbox/hooks/useAgentWorkspaces.ts) target/revision/local mutations；[useImageLibraryPage](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/capabilities/images/hooks/useImageLibraryPage.ts) pagination/revision；[useExplorerFileBrowser](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/capabilities/files/hooks/useExplorerFileBrowser.ts) Explorer 自身缓存/手动/本地操作。
- [useImageBuilds](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/capabilities/images/hooks/useImageBuilds.ts) 已有 push/reconnect，但 event 替换已在页内记录不重验筛选、pageState effect 更新存在窗口，旧 query 可能覆盖新 push；以确定性测试验证。
- [useGitRequest](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/a9d2c270c67a2206a47ccf1d79bfd99bc5214d62/web/src/capabilities/git/hooks/useGitRequest.ts) 现有 generation/request fence；Git watcher epoch 重置风险由 **#4455 已决定彻底移除 watcher**，本 Issue 不另修/恢复 obsolete watcher。遵循 #4455/#4456/#4457/#4458 的独立 scope；#1008、#2787、#2878、#2864、#343 为历史/相关证据，保持历史 acceptance；#3358/#3990 已有连接恢复/协议目录保护需保留；#4405 force summary、#4601 tmux discovery 由各自 owner 处理，本 Issue 不宣称修复后端。
- 去重检查 refresh/invalidation/stale/pull-to-refresh 的 open 与相关 closed 标题：未发现全前端统一 pull 生命周期 + 手动入口的同一 Requirement，Git V2 已拥有专门 Git 策略。若实施 inventory 发现同一缺陷已由其他 live Issue 负责，链接并消费，不重复修复。

### 1. Ownership / minimal architecture
建议 `web/src/platform/refresh/` 内小型 React-free PullController、RefreshLifecycle/Scheduler（可合并模块，避免过度设计）与 `usePullRefresh` React adapter；由 app composition 接入已认证 WebSocket connection state / physicalGeneration、visibilitychange/pageshow 与现有 Workspace activation。通用 scheduler 只管理 callback、due time、in-flight/queue budget，不持有业务数据/资源目录。Product/Capability 保留 list/detail、query scope、filter、pagination、mutation、selection、Jotai、API/plugin 所有权。同一已有业务 owner 的多个消费者共享该 owner 的 controller（不新增通用 cache/key registry）；独立列表的请求不互相覆盖。platform 不反向 import app/product/capability；host activation/refresh action 通过现有 contribution/viewBindings 传递。Explorer 等已有正确 owner 只接入 lifecycle/trigger，不复制其数据状态。
```ts
type RefreshReason = 'mount'|'activate'|'foreground'|'reconnect'|'interval'|'invalidate'|'mutation'|'manual'|'retry';
type PullOutcome = 'applied'|'superseded'|'failed'|'cancelled'|'partial';
interface PullRefreshOptions<T> {
  // Explicit owner-local identity (target/session incarnation/agent, page/filter, auth scope).
  context: readonly unknown[];
  active: boolean;
  enabled: boolean;
  pull(ctx: {reason: RefreshReason; signal: AbortSignal}): Promise<T>;
  apply(snapshot: T): void; // synchronous guarded publication
  policy: {intervalMs?: number; minIntervalMs?: number; timeoutMs: number;
    onForeground: boolean; onReconnect: boolean; onActivate: boolean};
}
// Result: refresh(reason) -> Promise<PullOutcome>; invalidate(reason);
// acceptExternal(snapshot) / fenceExternalUpdate(); loading, refreshing,
// stale/lastSuccessAt/error; names adaptable to existing API without changing semantics.
```
Pull and apply must be separated (including side effects such as protocol manifest publication); if transport cannot abort, late completion is logically fenced, bounded timeout and underlying transport request budget still required. No async apply outside guard.

### 2. Lifecycle and strategy
| Trigger | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| mount / valid target change | first active enabled authenticated read; target change retires old context immediately, not just effect after paint |
| activate | actual visible route/depth transition, even if component never unmounted; pull current scope |
| foreground / pageshow | after existing liveness probe/connection readiness succeeds, refresh active views; dedupe with reconnect; not window focus alone |
| reconnect | after authentication, active query scopes read again; physicalGeneration/auth change fences old data; inactive view dirty until activation |
| invalidate | existing matching notification only; dirty immediately, schedule while active; no new notifications required |
| mutation | apply valid authoritative post-state or schedule targeted read; dependencies decided by business owner, no global blanket invalidation |
| interval | only mounted/active/visible/connected/enabled; schedule after settling, no catch-up burst or overlapping setInterval; jitter ~10% |
| manual / retry | explicit current-scope query, priority over queued automatic reads; skip minInterval not auth/connection/transport limits; force when supported; expose outcome |
Full push: current-context complete snapshot can be directly applied under local generation fence, mark older outstanding pull superseded; do not trigger redundant pull unless dirty/partial. Invalidation-only push: coalesce. Cannot prove source ordering without server versions: preserve existing transport ordering guarantees and rely on next pull; no claim of distributed linearizability.

Default policy proposals (tunable based on observed cost): Session/Agent and running Image Builds 10–15s; visible Claude lists/Files/Sandbox/Project and ordinary mutable lists 30s; Env/Images/config/MCP/Skills 60s. First active/foreground/reconnect default on. For Git, **#4455 demand-only takes precedence**: mount/visible entry, target/depth change, manual, visible reconnect, mutation; interval off, no watcher/invalidation, no focus-only query (foreground on only if actual re-entry per #4455). Immutable history/large file/diff/stream/editor not periodically refreshed. GitHub externally rate-limited and expensive reads have explicit opt-out/longer policy. Maintain inventory of all exceptions and reasons. Sidebar/global lists active only when displayed or explicitly needed by a visible consumer; hidden cached route no periodic requests. Do not poll force session list automatically; manual force selected scope and retain stale_agents; existing server-side freshness limitations documented.

### 3. Pull concurrency / ordering / failure
State machine idle → queued → pulling → settled, with orthogonal dirty + active + stale flags; scope/connection local generation and monotonic request/event fence. One in-flight per owner/controller per current context, one bounded pending intent (merge reasons, manual stronger than automatic). Event during request marks dirty and captures invalidation counter; a settled request cannot clear newer dirty; if its result is superseded, reject stale publish and run trailing pull. On continuous events enforce bounded max coalescing delay (e.g. 500ms), do not starve other controllers. No independent timers per view. Scheduler default global in-flight 4, per Agent/routing target 2 where target known, bounded registrations/queue (one entry per live controller), fair automatic service and manual priority; these are initial policy values, not platform promises. Reconnect coalesces foreground/activate; timeout defaults align existing API timeout, automatic retries exponential 1/2/4/8… capped 30s with jitter, only while active/connected; manual retry can bypass backoff. Retire controllers/timers/listeners and resolve pending waiters on unmount/context change/disconnect/auth switch, StrictMode idempotent. Session A→B→A must not reuse generation. When manual force queued behind normal read, await actual force result, not normal response; repeated same-strength manual may share its in-flight proof, stronger triggers are retained. Partial/error/timeout/cancelled distinct; do not show misleading success.
Preserve last successful data on failure and disconnect, mark stale/unknown, initial load no-data error distinct from authoritative empty. Background refresh no full-page spinner, scroll/selection/filter/expanded state and drafts unchanged; deleted selection only cleared on valid current authoritative snapshot. Context/auth change clears unrelated state. Pagination keeps current filter/page, authoritative count, clamp invalid page; do not reset on background refresh, append history only under existing cursor semantics. No optimistic list mutation guesses unless existing business owner explicitly owns it. Per-controller status feeds UI without taking ownership of domain state.

### 4. Manual refresh UX — all mutable remote list surfaces
- Web: reuse existing toolbar or search disclosure for Sessions (canonical interaction/web.md already places filter/sort/refresh in disclosure); other lists use existing Header actions or shared menu/icon with accessible name Refresh, tooltip, keyboard support, predictable location. No duplicate header/toolbar or global reload.
- App: every list has a visible, non-gesture accessible Refresh action (existing header/search overflow or equivalent shell action), available even when data is empty/failed. Add optional shared pull-to-refresh in the existing host-owned vertical scroll region as an accelerator for eligible list pages. Capabilities contribute callback + refresh state, never implement a second scroll container/page header/gesture. No permanent refresh row, preserve App interaction contract; update canonical interaction docs to clarify the added action. On a list top, downward vertical drag after axis lock and threshold (initial 64 CSS px, tune in prototype), release commits once; cancelled/short drag no request. No capture while not at top, horizontal swipe/edge guards, nested scroller, Terminal/editor/selection/modal/IME own interaction; prevent browser native double refresh only for accepted gesture, maintain capsule clearance, use existing motion/reduced-motion tokens. Excluded surface retains explicit action where applicable. Shared host owns indicator, release, settling and cancellation, including page switch while request runs.
- Manual refresh: show inline busy/indicator only until the corresponding promise settles; repeated taps coalesce; user failure/partial outcome actionable, no toast storm for automatic failures; retain last known data and allow retry. Do not imply server freshness if only cached registry was read. Last-success/stale status can be progressively disclosed, not a new persistent status row.
- Audit both Web and App even if same Hook; no gesture-only accessibility and no mandatory refresh button inside immutable history/editor.

### 5. Migration inventory and delivery
1. Build minimal shared lifecycle/controller, test with fake clock and controlled promises, preserve existing WS plugin semantics; add global signal wiring and representative UI primitives.
2. Migrate Session, Agent, dashboard/shell/selection/detail lists; fix Agent comparison (data always updated independently of render selectors), same-connection request/push/manifest ordering, preserve Session incarnation/force/stale semantics. Review existing setSessions/setAgents direct writers.
3. Inventory every mounted capability page and list from app contribution registry and routes: Claude conversations/transcripts/config/MCP/memory/Skills, Files Explorer/current directory, Env profiles/bindings, Commands, Git status/branches/worktrees/history/GitHub (respect #4455/#4456), Images library/builds/cache, Sandbox Workspaces, Project, Agent processes/probe and any other actual remote mutable list. Record path, owner, active signal, query/force, policy, mutation/push, explicit Web/App action, exception, test ID. Unimplemented feature not counted as shipped. Existing streaming/pagination/Explorer owners are adapters not rewritten. Fix ImageBuilds authoritative filtered page refresh (matching event invalidates query, no guessed total).
4. Migrate all live mutable remote list consumers or document explicit justified exclusion. No leftover duplicate timers/race logic for migrated reads; preserve intentional domain version checks. Update docs/knowledge and focused quality Gates; extend existing canonical browser specs, no blanket Full regression dependency.

### 6. Evidence & observability
Development proof uses existing Vitest/unit/integration, Web lint/typecheck, design-system Gates and Chromium + Playwright fixture/browser CI, exact PR-head authenticated CI outputs; no production fault injection/credentials required. Test deterministic time, deferred Promise, synthetic reconnect/visibility/activation and external pushes; end-to-end selected fixture suites assert visible rows, actual request counts/reasons, refresh action, scroll/selection and errors (desktop/mobile touch). Test actual existing force API via request spy plus existing session lifecycle E2E, not claim new server guarantees. For 100 event burst use controlled same-tick test, count actual pulls (not just scheduled calls); test continuous events and queue fairness separately. Low-cardinality debug/telemetry at existing Web observability owner; no new monitoring backend. Report known limits (API freshness, hidden views, rate limits); initial interval/concurrency defaults subject to measured adjustment.

### Prototype
- Decision: Required for App host pull gesture; Web existing refresh action placement is precise reuse.
- Reason: vertical pull vs existing horizontal Swipe/nested scroll/OS gesture/capsule layout conflict; avoid divergent capability implementations.
- Scenario: list top → short pull cancel → qualified pull release → existing rows and indicator → failure/retry; compare list scrolled/non-top, horizontal swipe, nested scroller and explicit action; desktop existing menu. Validate Chromium mobile/touch and desktop; no actual Safari claim.
- Status: Published and browser-verified 2026-11-27; gesture design settled for production port.
- Artifact: https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/app-pull-refresh-4602/index.html (live HTTPS 200, manifest SHA aa84d6a115a332134337f556a98b800a02570c73). Source: https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/aa84d6a115a332134337f556a98b800a02570c73/app-pull-refresh-4602

### Interactive prototype

- Preview (browser HTML): https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/app-pull-refresh-4602/index.html
- Immutable source: https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/aa84d6a115a332134337f556a98b800a02570c73/app-pull-refresh-4602
- Scenario/fidelity: `app-pull-refresh-4602/README.md` on the `prototype` branch.
- Mocked: rows, latency, failure, gesture indicator, Capsule inset. Live: none (no transport, no backend).
- Checks: `node --test app-pull-refresh-4602/smoke-test.mjs` 10/10 pass. Chromium pointer-event walkthrough at 390/375: short pull cancels with no request; qualified pull commits once and applies; selection retained; non-top, horizontal pager, nested scroller and Terminal contacts all surrender; header Refresh present and functional in healthy/empty/error. Console clean apart from favicon 404.
- Limits: Chromium touch emulation only, no Safari/physical-device claim; a mock is not production acceptance. SC-05 still requires exact-head browser proof after implementation. Existing App swipe #2724 and Workspace #3971 contracts retained. Use Nession web-design router, existing shadcn/Nession pattern; no external install needed.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 Session/Agent 及所有当前可变远程列表均有可核查的刷新策略清单（页面、owner、数据上下文、触发、周期/例外、手动入口、错误语义、测试）；新增列表遵循同一规范；业务状态/API/协议保持各自所有权，不存在 Resource Registry、统一业务缓存或新后端协议。
- [x] SC-02 前端确定性时钟与连接测试证明首次有效激活、再次激活、前台恢复、认证连接恢复、定时及业务失效分别触发正确 Pull；后台、隐藏能力、断线不发起周期请求，恢复时合并重复信号且无定时器/监听器泄漏。
- [x] SC-03 可控 deferred Promise 测试证明每 controller 同一上下文最多一个在途查询及一个合并待办；重复事件、持续失效、超时、重连、目标 A→B→A、卸载/StrictMode、完整推送和 mutation 后的旧响应均不会回退数据或错误/loading；手动 force 不被普通查询吞掉，Promise 只在对应刷新完成/失败/取消后结算。
- [x] SC-04 Session/Agent 浏览器和 hook 回归证明外部创建/删除/变更可通过既有推送或下一轮可见 Pull 收敛；Agent metadata/address/protocol 等变化不被 UI 比较吞掉，旧 Agent reply 不回退列表或协议目录；Session 手动刷新执行 force，部分 Agent 超时仍保留已知记录并显示不确定状态；正常失败不变成空列表。
- [x] SC-05 Chromium desktop/mobile 可变列表（含空、错误、已有数据）有可发现、可键盘/触摸操作的手动刷新入口，Web 保留既有 Header/Search disclosure，App 使用统一 Host 下拉及非手势备选；刷新状态真实、失败可重试、滚动/选中/展开/编辑保持；下拉不会抢横向 Swipe、Terminal、嵌套滚动或浏览器原生手势，不破坏 Workspace 胶囊避让。
- [x] SC-06 代表性能力 Claude Transcript/Env/Files/Sandbox/Image Library/Builds/Project/Git 的 exact-head 测试和浏览器清单证明可见列表能按声明策略更新、手动查询当前 scope；Image Builds 变更后筛选/分页/total 与权威结果一致，旧页不能覆盖新页；Git 严格保留 #4455 的 demand-only 例外，不恢复常驻 watcher/interval/focus-only 拉取。
- [x] SC-07 可控负载测试中同一 controller 100 次同步失效合并为至多一次当前读加一次后续读，4 并发上限及队列公平性、超时退避、手动优先、后台暂停可被断言；记录按 owner/reason 聚合的 pull、合并、失败、丢弃、延迟与成功时间，不使用 session/path 等高基数字段。
- [x] SC-08 canonical Web architecture、Web 工程规范与相关交互文档记载统一刷新契约、例外与所有权；PR 提供与 Git/WS/前端相关知识条目对照的更新内容和 exact-SHA 来源计划，明确可信 ledger 发布的 owner 和后续验证，不以 PR 内容声称实际发布。

**SC → scenario / proof:** SC-01/02/03 → SCN-01 (source + exact-head independently executed Web test/Gate, positive/negative deferred/fake-clock cases); SC-04/05/06 → SCN-02 (exact-head Chromium/Playwright existing approved browser CI fixtures + hook tests, DOM/action/request assertions and traces, no production or physical mobile claim); SC-07 → SCN-06 (deterministic workload, fake clock/request counts, controlled budget/failure samples in exact-head Web test CI); SC-08 → SCN-08 (exact-source doc/ledger/schema/link checks and authenticated Knowledge publication when applicable; no claim of publication based on PR source alone). For SC-08 PR evidence verifies canonical source and update-ready Knowledge diff/plan; actual trusted ledger publication remains a separately tracked owner action and is not fabricated as PR proof. All PR criteria use agent reviewing independent exact-head CI evidence, not agent opinion; selected E2E/Case Smoke supplies runtime evidence. Verification scoped to affected Web integration, no Full regression requirement.
